task.aggregation: time mean over [0,4); constant reference and force

selection.criterion: mean log incumbent/initial-design-best at FE20/40/60 across development seeds

failure_curve_policy: Retain best observed value after failure; failures reported separately.
trace_sampling: every 10th sample, 20 ms; full histories remain in raw per-query results, full transient traces are regenerated by the objective
